scope: Review of permitted trial tool-use/results and final answers; no new source retrieval was performed by the reviewer.

product_workflow.A: Google Contacts was present only in search summaries; the external workflow was not inspected.
product_workflow.B: Google Contacts was present only in search summaries; the external workflow was not inspected.

candidate_evidence.A: npm metadata and a dry-run package listing established PapaParse 5.7.0, MIT and published file sizes. The final approximate ten-times-size comparison was overstated against the 8771-byte app: 51200/8771 is about 5.8, and 18900/8771 about 2.2. A acknowledged the library was usable and chose custom code as a local size/maintenance tradeoff.
candidate_evidence.B: Tools fetched RFC text and published PapaParse 5.5.3 and d3-dsv 3 resources. The executed comparison script included PapaParse. The final claim of running the same twelve cases against d3-dsv was not supported by that script or its tool output.

failure_evidence.A: Worker browser results included malformed input rejection with state preserved. Independent acceptance confirmed it.
failure_evidence.B: Worker results support its 35/35 self-test count, but did not include the unterminated-quote counterexample. The independent real file-input test and same-input recheck both observed an erroneous inserted contact and success-only feedback.

encoding_limit: Both variants decoded the one independently tested GB18030 sample correctly. This does not establish all Excel export formats or encoding detection correctness.
reviewer_isolation_limit: While filtering tool results for memory-related actions, the reviewer accidentally saw some B skill content. This review is not fully blinded. The condition-to-version mapping remained undisclosed to that reviewer.

scope_observations.A: A started a local test server; its stop command was denied. No matching process remained in the coordinator check after CLI completion. An external memory-directory creation was denied, with no successful memory write observed. Five successful Write calls targeted test scripts in a shared system Temp probe directory, whose current contents include generated CSVs and screenshots. The coordinator backed up all sixteen current files and verified hashes; the source directory was retained because no pre-trial inventory establishes exclusive ownership of the whole directory.
scope_observations.B: One external project-memory note was created. Its attempted index write was denied. The coordinator verified the successful write and ownership, backed up matching bytes, then removed only the trial-created note.
